tracks.purpose: Numerical and execution qualification; no performance ranking.
Identical discrete model and gradient engine comparison; adapted-canonical and native-optimized implementations identified.
Identical original equations and local learning update rules; no invented BPTT baseline.
Same task and resource/tuning budget, possibly different learning algorithm; time-to-quality and Pareto results.
Capability frontier and fitting; no forced comparison of inequivalent models or solvers.
Migration effort and before/after-training independent replay.

canonical_lif_v1.scheduling: For every tick, compute all non-input populations' drift and thresholds from prior state; only then propagate input/current-tick presynaptic spikes and apply subtract reset.
equations: v_(t+1) = u_t + W * (x_t for input edges, s_t for internal edges) - theta * stop_gradient(s_t)
canonical_lif_v1.loss: cross_entropy(logits=5 * mean_over_time(output_spikes), target), mean over global batch
canonical_lif_v1.note: This is a synchronous reference fixture, not a claim about each framework's default neuron semantics.

multistate.note: An arbitrary four-state equation is not HH.

stochastic.policy: Store common realized random draws and hashes for strict comparisons; equal seeds alone are insufficient.

precision_profiles.note: Atlas observed forward/backward FP32 and host FP64 optimizer profile. Match precision and gradient contract, not implementation placement. Re-audit selected backend and include its real transfer costs.
precision_profiles.profile_scope: Observed v3/v4 GPU path; re-audit selected build, including any v5 path, before execution freeze.
precision_profiles.parameter_cast: cast master parameters to float32 on each public execution
precision_profiles.batch_gradient_reduction: cast each sample gradient to float64, accumulate in declared sample order and apply global-batch normalization
precision_profiles.batch_loss_reduction: convert sample loss to float64 and compute mean
precision_profiles.mpi_reduction: Record exact rank order, normalization, accumulator dtype and collective in selected build; currently unresolved.
precision_profiles.placement_policy: Matching the numerical contract does not require competitors to copy Atlas placement or launch structure. A device-resident float64 optimizer is legal if qualified. Record all actual transfers and placement.

precision_profiles.note: AMP/TF32 and mixed profiles have independent quality results; no strict-engine ratio across profiles.

semantic_profiles.full_bptt_policy: Checkpoint/recompute or lossless compression is legal after gradient qualification. TBPTT is a separate learning algorithm. Atlas TBPTT currently retains a full-sequence tape.

Only timestamp extents may be read from test data for this shape manifest; test labels and scores remain sealed. Freeze preprocessing and exact T before fitting or timing. No event truncation.
workloads.readout: frozen before execution; canonical profile if qualified

hpo.selection: Mean validation accuracy across the two tuning seeds; failed runs score 0 for selection and remain visible. Tie-break by lower total tuning wall time, then configuration ID. No best-seed selection.
hpo.budget: same trial and wall-time ceilings, same device budget; report both actual resource usage and achieved quality
hpo.trial_definition: One trial denotes a configuration; evaluate both tuning seeds 101 and 103. Each training run has a separate 10-epoch or 1800-second ceiling.

workloads.note: No parameter identifiability claim from low voltage error alone.

shd.test_policy: Timestamp extent only is allowed for fixed input-shape metadata; test labels and scores are sealed until final selected-checkpoint evaluation. No hyperparameter or model selection from test.

parallel_contracts.meaning: Different seeds or parameter trials; not acceleration of one training update.
Same global batch, sample order, loss normalization and optimizer update; divide across ranks.
Same local batch, increased global batch; report throughput separately and remeasure quality.
Declare placement of parameters, optimizer state, recurrent state, activations and tape separately.
Compare same total physical resources and global batch on one versus two physical hosts.

Optional preregistered implementation variant: same global batch, sequence, initialization and loss normalization; sum gradients then perform exactly one Adam update. Carry all necessary state correctly. Includes every microbatch public call and launch.
parallel_contracts.qualification: Independent Q0 full-gradient and optimizer-update comparison including accumulation precision. Do not assume available in Atlas public API.
parallel_contracts.note: No silent runtime substitution for a budget_rejected monolithic case; report both cells. Not equivalent when batch-dependent operations or differing state semantics change the model.

qualification.oracle: Independent NumPy or Torch/custom-VJP implementation and Brian forward comparison where applicable; not only Atlas CPU versus Atlas GPU.
qualification.finite_difference: Only smooth subgraphs. A hard-threshold finite difference is not a valid surrogate-gradient oracle.

tolerances.spike_events: Exact agreement on fixtures with a recorded positive threshold margin; boundary fixtures separately classified.

qualification.tolerance_change_policy: Any justified revision creates a new protocol revision before performance comparisons; never silently relax after seeing a contender fail.

measurement.timeout_policy: At the cap record execution_status=timeout, termination_reason=wall_time_cap and completed-work count; never silently shrink model/batch/T or score a partial run as completed.
measurement.warm_definition: Exclude one-time model construction/compilation, but include all recurring public API work, including Atlas process/MPI launch costs.
measurement.cold_definition: New process with empty framework compilation cache; report cache state and complete time to first valid optimizer update.
measurement.task_scope: Preparation/compile + data loading + all training and validation + recovery; report components and total separately. Download time separately, no hidden compile advantage.
measurement.async_synchronization: Primary wall time is the coordinator's complete public API call through all-rank completion, including serialization, files and launch. Synchronize all devices at boundaries. Maximum rank elapsed time is a separate distributed-work diagnostic, never a replacement for coordinator wall time.
measurement.statistics: Process-level distributions, paired training seeds, median and uncertainty; steps within one process are not independent replicates. Report all seeds and failures.
measurement.optimized_baselines: Default correct configuration plus strongest documented and qualified legal backend/checkpoint configuration. Record adaptation effort; do not constrain competitors to intentionally slow Python loops.
measurement.seed_repetition_mapping: Five independent processes, one seed per process in order [11,23,37,51,71], each with 10 warmup and 50 measured steps; not 5 seeds times 5 processes.

admission_preflight.note: For capacity tests use the published supported maximum, not the 64 MiB default. A 64 MiB JSON or 1 GiB tape admission limit is a software budget rejection, not observed physical OOM.

capacity_boundary_refinement.strategy: After adjacent success/failure on the preregistered width or T ladder, insert at most three floor(sqrt(lower*upper)) integer geometric midpoints while other dimensions stay fixed. Stop if no integer lies strictly between bounds.
capacity_boundary_refinement.repetitions: Re-run every inserted size with the same five-process rule or its preregistered capped variant.
capacity_boundary_refinement.note: If the highest ladder point succeeds, report at least that capacity, not a measured maximum. For software admission failures, report the admitted bound separately from physical memory.

result_schema.status_note: Capability, numerical qualification, execution, quality and termination are separate fields. Software admission rejection is not measured OOM. Missing hardware is not framework unsupported. Completed execution need not meet quality; timeout and quality_not_reached can coexist.
result_schema.counterfactual_status_policy: Not applicable and unqualified rows remain visible and are never converted into infinite speedups.

requirements: all failure and unsupported rows visible
productization_candidate.note: Internal suggested threshold, not an industry standard or an established result. Capacity and speed are separate claims.

quality_noninferiority.statistical_rule: Preregister paired-seed confidence interval method before freeze; a wide interval is inconclusive, not equivalence.

decision_rules.go: Prioritize a named model family if cost, capacity or migration benefit survives strong optimized competitors.
decision_rules.no_go: Do not market engine leadership if benefit exists only versus a weak baseline, inequivalent algorithm, different precision, or omitted startup.

task_value.note: Internal candidate rule; all seeds, quality uncertainty and total task cost remain visible.

distributed_value.note: Same global batch and complete public-step boundary, same numeric and resource contract. Product-value candidate, not MPI correctness acceptance.
